method.ordering: rotate the first policy each round; each policy receives the same original records and a fresh shared deadline
method.index: empty native handle; supplied-source projection only, not catalog or index-size qualification
method.memory: sampled whole-process RSS, including retained inputs and comparison outcomes; not isolated allocations or a per-request native peak
method.latency: consumer wall time includes correctness checks and recovery bookkeeping; per-call latency covers the awaited public API
method.inputCounts: submissions and repeated-ID submissions are observed; accepted consumer inputs and page statuses are progress, not native tokenization/provisional work
method.terminalPolicy: consume incomplete singletons once; retain proven evidence and explicit unknown/partial state; never retry an error or expired shared budget; preserve prior accepted inputs
method.legacyState: complete legacy singletons prove membership/evidence; incomplete legacy singletons cannot distinguish incomplete analysis from incomplete spans

scope: Verification performed after successful benchmark process exit; qualified source includes uncommitted tracked changes. Source and compiled artifact fingerprints appear in environment row.
